info.name: PaoPizza API
info.description:
Backend API for PaoPizza.

Base path: `/api/v1`

Mounted modules: auth, users, customers, cart, employees, supplier, ingredient, categories, stores, products, combos, menus, inventory, orders, payments, promotions, revenue, media, shifts.
Schedule/payroll currently only have models/seed data.

Auth: Passport Local + JWT Bearer + refresh token cookie.

Sample seed login:
- Admin: `admin` / `BAO123@az`
- Employee: `emp_02` / `12345678`
- Customer (phone as username): `0918000001` / `12345678`

request.description:
Basic service health endpoint.

**Response 200**:
```json
{
  "status": "OK",
  "timestamp": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
}
```

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Authentication endpoints using Passport.js.

- **Local strategy**: username/password login
- **JWT strategy**: Bearer token from `Authorization` header
- **Refresh token**: stored in httpOnly cookie (`refreshToken`)
- **Access token**: expires in 1 day
- **Refresh token**: expires in 7 days

request.description:
Login for Employee accounts via Passport local strategy.

Will reject if `user_type` is `Customer`.

**Body**:
| Field | Type | Required |
|-------|------|----------|
| username | string | Yes |
| password | string | Yes |

**Response 200**:
```json
{
  "message": "Đăng nhập thành công",
  "accessToken": "JWT string",
  "user": { "id": "...", "email": "...", "role": "admin" }
}
```
+ Sets `refreshToken` httpOnly cookie (7 days)

**Response 403**: `{ "message": "Vui lòng đăng nhập bằng tài khoản nhân viên !" }`
**Response 401**: Passport authentication failed

response.name: 403 - Wrong User Type

request.description:
Login for Customer accounts via Passport local strategy.

Will reject if `user_type` is `Employee`.

Customer seed accounts use phone number as username.

**Body**:
| Field | Type | Required |

| username | string | Yes |
| password | string | Yes |

**Response 200**:
```json
{
  "message": "Đăng nhập thành công",
  "accessToken": "JWT string",
  "user": { "id": "...", "email": "...", "role": null }
}
```
+ Sets `refreshToken` httpOnly cookie (7 days)

**Response 403**: `{ "message": "Vui lòng đăng nhập bằng tài khoản khách hàng !" }`
**Response 401**: Passport authentication failed

response.name: 403 - Wrong User Type

request.description:
Refresh the access token using the `refreshToken` httpOnly cookie.

Postman cookie jar should keep the cookie after login.

**Response 200**:
```json
{
  "accessToken": "new JWT string"
}
```
+ Sets new `refreshToken` httpOnly cookie

**Response 401**: `{ "message": "Không tìm thấy Refresh Token" }`
**Response 403**: `{ "message": "<error message>" }` (clears cookie)

Clears the `refreshToken` httpOnly cookie.

**Response 200**:
```json
{
  "message": "Đăng xuất thành công"
}
```

Change authenticated user's password.
Requires valid JWT token.

**Headers**:
- Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}

**Body**:
- oldPass: current password
- newPass: new password (min 6 chars)

**Note**: Uses req.user.id from JWT, do not send user_id.

response.name: 200 - Success

item.name: Users
item.description:
User account management.

- Create, update, and query user accounts
- `Create`, `Get All`, `Get By Id`, and `Update Status` require **admin** role (JWT + admin)
- `Get Me` requires valid JWT
- `Update` is currently **public** (no auth middleware)

request.description:
Create a new user account. **Requires JWT + admin role.**

**Body**:
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| username | string | Yes | unique, min 3 chars |
| password | string | Yes | min 6 chars |
| user_type | string | Yes | `Employee` or `Customer` |
| role | string | Yes for Employee | `admin`, `manager`, `staff` (null for Customer) |
| ref_id | ObjectId | Yes | Reference to Employee or Customer document |
| status | boolean | No | default: true |

**Response 201**:
```json
{
  "message": "Tạo tài khoản thành công",
  "data": { ...user without password }
}
```

**Response 400**: `{ "message": "<validation error>" }`

Get all user accounts with `ref_id` populated. **Requires JWT + admin role.**

**Response 200**:
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "_id": "...",
      "username": "admin_q1",
      "user_type": "Employee",
      "role": "admin",
      "ref_id": { ...populated employee/customer },
      "status": true
    }
  ]
}
```

**Response 500**: `{ "message": "Lỗi server khi lấy danh sách tài khoản" }`

response.name: 200 - Profile

request.description:
Toggle user active/inactive status. **Requires JWT + admin role.**

**Params**: `id` - MongoDB ObjectId

**Body**:
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| status | boolean | Yes | `true` or `false` only |

**Response 200**:
```json
{
  "message": "Cập nhật trạng thái thành công",
  "data": { ...updated user }
}
```

**Response 400**: `{ "message": "Trạng thái không hợp lệ" }`

response.name: 200 - Status Updated

request.description:
Update user fields (except password). **Currently public (no auth middleware).**

**Params**: `id` - MongoDB ObjectId

**Body** (any user fields except `password`):
| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| username | string | unique check applied |
| role | string | `admin`, `manager`, `staff` |
| status | boolean | |
| user_type | string | `Employee`, `Customer` |

**Note**: `password` field is stripped from the request body.

**Response 200**:
```json
{
  "message": "Cập nhật thông tin tài khoản thành công",
  "data": { ...updated user without password }
}
```

**Response 400**: `{ "message": "<error message>" }`

response.name: 200 - Updated

item.name: Customers
item.description:
Customer registration and update.

**Updated**: register creates Customer first then linked User (username = phone for login, rollback on User failure by deleting Customer). Update uses user_id to find ref_id in Customer. Public register, auth for update. Matches service logic (phone as username for customers).

Customer fields include `currentPoint`, `totalPoint`, `tier` (member/silver/gold/diamond), and `listAddress` (delivery addresses managed via Add Address).

request.description:
Register new customer (updated). **Public.** Validates phone/password/name. Username internally = phone for login. Creates Customer first, then linked User (ref_id). Rollback deletes Customer on failure. Matches current controller/service.

**Body**:
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| password | string | Yes | min 6 |
| name | string | Yes | display name |
| phone | string | Yes | used as username, unique |
| email | string | No | unique, lowercase |

**Note**: Manage delivery addresses via `Add Customer Address`.

**Response 201**:
```json
{
  "message": "Đăng ký tài khoản khách hàng thành công",
  "data": {
    "account": { ...user without password, username=phone },
    "profile": { ...customer }
  }
}
```

**Response 400**: `{ "message": "Vui lòng điền đầy đủ Số điện thoại, Mật khẩu và Tên " }` (updated validation).

response.name: 201 - Registered
400 - Missing Fields

item.name: Employees
item.description:
Employee management.

Creates both an `Employee` profile and a `User` account with `user_type: Employee`.

Uses **Zod** validation with `.strict()` mode (no extra fields allowed).

body.raw:
{
  "username": "newstaff02",
  "password": "12345678",
  "store_id": "{{storeId}}",
  "name": "Tran Van B",
  "birthday": "1995-05-15",
  "email": "newstaff02@paopizza.com",
  "phone": "0900123456",
  "station": "cashier",
  "salary_type": "hourly",
  "role": "staff",
  "address": "456 Nguyen Hue, Q1, HCM",
  "salary": 30000
}

request.description:
Create a new employee with user account. Requires JWT + admin/manager.

Uses Zod `.strict()` validation - **no extra fields allowed**.

**Body** (Zod validated):
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| username | string | Yes | min 3, max 30 |
| password | string | Yes | min 6 |
| store_id | string | No | MongoDB ObjectId as string (optional) |
| name | string | Yes | min 2, max 100 |
| birthday | date string | Yes | must be in the past |
| email | string | Yes | valid email |
| phone | string | Yes | regex `/^[0-9]{10,11}$/` |
| station | enum | Yes | `manager`, `store_manager`, `cashier`, `kitchen`, `delivery`, `barista` |
| salary_type | enum | No | `hourly`, `monthly` (default: `hourly`) |
| role | enum | No | `admin`, `manager`, `staff` (default: `staff`) |
| address | string | No | |
| salary | number | No | min 0 |

**Response 201**:
```json
{
  "message": "Tạo nhân viên thành công",
  "data": {
    "account": { ...user without password },
    "profile": { ...employee object }
  }
}
```

**Response 400 (Zod)**:
```json
{
  "message": "Validation error",
  "errors": [
    { "field": "phone", "message": "Số điện thoại phải có 10-11 chữ số" }
  ]
}
```

response.name: 201 - Created
400 - Validation Error

item.name: Shifts
item.description:
Shift scheduling and attendance.

Fields: store_id, date, start_time, end_time, list_employee[].
Station: maker|drink|cashier|delivery. Status: PENDING|APPROVED|WORKING|DONE.

request.description: Get shift list with optional filters: store_id, employee_id, status, from_date/to_date, or exact date with date=YYYY-MM-DD. Requires JWT + manager/admin.

Employee registers a shift by date/time. If no shift exists for the same store/date/start/end, a new shift is created with status PENDING. If a matching shift exists, the employee is appended to list_employee. Requires JWT.

Update shift fields by shift_id. Include list_employee to replace entire list. Requires JWT + manager/admin.
Hard delete shift by id. Requires JWT + manager/admin.
Add an employee to shift list_employee. Requires JWT + manager/admin.
Update station/status/check_in/check_out for a staff member in shift. Requires JWT.
Remove an employee from a shift. Requires JWT + manager/admin.

item.name: Cart
item.description:
Shopping cart management.

All routes require JWT. Cart is identified by `userId` (mapped to `user_id` in DB).

Support 2 item types: `product` and `combo`.
- Product items: require `product_id`, optional `added_topping` (array of Ingredient ObjectIds)
- Combo items: require `combo`, optional `combo_selections` (array of { product_id, sku, size, added_topping })

request.description:
Add a product item to cart. If same `item_type` + `product_id` + `size` already exists, quantity is increased. **Requires JWT.**

**Body**:
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| userId | string | Yes | User ObjectId |
| item_type | string | No | 'product' (default) or 'combo' |
| product_id | string | Yes* | Required when item_type='product' |
| size | string | Yes | Must match product variant size |
| quantity | number | No | default: 1, must be >= 1 |
| note | string | No | default: '' |
| added_topping | [object] | No | [{ ingredient: ObjectId, quantity: number }] |

Add a combo item to cart. If same `item_type` + `combo` + `size` already exists, quantity is increased. **Requires JWT.**

**Body**:
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| userId | string | Yes | User ObjectId |
| item_type | string | Yes | 'combo' |
| combo | string | Yes | Combo ObjectId |
| size | string | Yes | Size identifier |
| quantity | number | No | default: 1, must be >= 1 |
| note | string | No | default: '' |
| combo_selections | [object] | No | [{ product_id, sku, crust, size, added_topping: [{ ingredient, quantity }] }] |

Remove one cart item by `item_type` + (`product_id` or `combo`) + `size`. Body requires: `userId`, `size`. For product: `item_type='product'`, `product_id`. For combo: `item_type='combo'`, `combo`. **Requires JWT.**

response.name: 200 - Removed

request.description: Update quantity/note/topping of an existing cart item. Body requires: `userId`, `size` + (`product_id` for product, `combo` for combo). Optional: `quantity`, `note`, `added_topping`. If `quantity < 1`, item is removed. **Requires JWT.**

response.name: 200 - Updated

item.name: Product
item.description:
Product management with variants.

- `GET /products` is public
- `GET /products/:product_id` and `GET /products/category/:category_id` require JWT
- Create/Update/Delete require admin
- Schema field mapping: `category`, `variants.image`, `variants.recipe[].ingredient`
- Create/Update still accept multipart field `images` (max 5 files), but image data should be provided in `variants` JSON

request.description: Get all active products (`isDeleted=false`, `isActive=true`). Public endpoint.
Get all active products (isDeleted=false, isActive=true). Public endpoint.
Get product detail by product_id. **Requires JWT.**

Create product. **Requires JWT + admin.**

Send as `multipart/form-data`:
- Use `category` (not `category_id`)
- `variants` must be JSON string (array) with `image` and `recipe[].ingredient`
- Field `images` (file) is accepted by route but model stores image data at variant level

Update product by `product_id` in body. **Requires JWT + admin.**

Use `variants` JSON with `image` and `recipe[].ingredient`.
Field `images` (file) is accepted by route but model stores image data at variant level.

item.name: Combos
item.description:
Combo management. Includes creating combos with complex rules, activating/deactivating, uploading images, and querying.

**pricingType**: `static` (fixed price, requires `price`) or `dynamic` (price auto-calculated from items).

**Rules** support `applicableCategories`, `applicableProducts`, `applicableSizes`, and `requiredQuantity`.

All modifications require JWT auth with 'admin' role.

response.name: 200 - OK (List of Combos)

request.description: Get list of all currently active combos.

response.name: 200 - OK (Active Combos)

request.description:
Create a new combo. Requires JWT auth with 'admin' role.

**Body fields**:
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| name | string | Yes | Unique combo name |
| description | string | No | |
| dateStart | ISO date | Yes | |
| dateEnd | ISO date | Yes | |
| pricingType | enum | No | `static` (default) or `dynamic` |
| discountType | enum | Yes | `percent` or `amount` |
| discount | number | Yes | Discount value |
| price | number | Only if static | Fixed combo price |
| isActive | boolean | No | Default true |
| rules | array | Yes | At least 1 rule required |

**Rule fields**:
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| groupName | string | Yes | Rule label |
| applicableCategories | ObjectId[] | No | Category refs |
| applicableProducts | ObjectId[] | No | Product refs |
| applicableSizes | string[] | No | e.g. ["S", "M", "L"] or ["330ml", "1L"] |
| requiredQuantity | number | Yes | Min 1 |

At least one of applicableCategories/applicableProducts required per rule.

Get menu by store_id. Public endpoint.

Update menu by menu_id. Requires JWT + admin.
Toggle or set menu status. Requires JWT + admin.
Delete menu (hard delete). Requires JWT + admin.

item.name: Store
item.description:
Store management endpoints.

Store model fields include: `name`, `address`, `location`, `phone`, `email`, `time_open`, `time_close`, `manager_by`, `status`.
`address` is stored as an object: `{ streetNumber, district, city }`.
`location` is stored as a GeoJSON Point: `{ type: "Point", coordinates: [lng, lat] }`.
`manager_by` references an Employee ID.
State values in model: `active`, `maintenance`, `close`.

request.description: Get all stores. Supports query filtering by city, district, and status. Public endpoint.

Create store. Requires JWT + admin.

Required fields: name, address (with streetNumber, district, city), phone, email, time_open, time_close.
Optional fields: location (coordinates array: [longitude, latitude]), manager_by (Employee ID).
Time format must be HH:mm (24h).

Update store by store_id. Requires JWT + admin.

Can update any store fields in the schema including address object subfields, location coordinates, and manager_by.
Close store by setting status="close". Requires JWT + admin.

item.name: Inventory
item.description: Inventory management endpoints. One inventory document per store with an ingredients array.

request.description: Get inventory for a store. Returns full ingredient list with default 0 if not in stock list. Requires JWT + manager/admin.
Get low-stock ingredient items where current_stock < min_stock_level. Requires JWT + admin.
Upsert ingredient entry inside a store inventory (one doc per store). Optional `source` and `log_action` to control activity log. Requires JWT + admin.
Adjust stock quantity for one ingredient inside a store inventory. type: add | reduce. Requires JWT + admin.
Update inventory quantities after shift summary. `payload` can be array of {item_id, current_stock, min_stock_level?} or an object map { item_id: current_stock }. Requires JWT + manager/admin.
Hard delete inventory by id. Requires JWT + admin.

item.name: Orders
item.description:
Order management endpoints.

Items support 2 types: `product` and `combo`.
- Product items: require `item_type='product'`, `product_id`, `sku`, `size`. Optional: `added_topping`
- Combo items: require `item_type='combo'`, `combo`, `size`. Optional: `combo_selections`

request.description:
Create order. Price is auto-resolved from product variant by size (product) or combo price (combo). customer_id/employee_id should be ObjectId or null. Requires JWT.

**Items fields**:
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| item_type | string | Yes | 'product' or 'combo' |
| product_id | string | Yes* | Required when item_type='product' |
| combo | string | Yes* | Required when item_type='combo' |
| sku | string | Yes | SKU from variant |
| size | string | Yes | Size identifier |
| quantity | number | No | default: 1 |
| note | string | No | default: '' |
| added_topping | [object] | No | [{ ingredient: ObjectId, quantity: number }] |
| combo_selections | [object] | No | For combo: [{ product_id, sku, crust, size, added_topping }] |
Get order list. Supports query filters. Requires JWT + manager/admin role.
Get current logged-in customer order history. Requires JWT.
Get one order by id. Requires JWT.
Check whether the order payment is successful. Requires JWT.
Update order status (pending|confirmed|preparing|completed|cancelled|delivering). Requires JWT + admin|manager|staff.
Manual payment status update for cash orders at counter. paymentStatus: pending|success|failed. Requires JWT + admin|staff.
Customer cancels their own order (only if status is pending). Requires JWT.
Staff cancels an order. Requires JWT + admin|manager|staff.
Update order payment status (pending|success|failed). Requires JWT + admin|manager|staff.
Soft delete order (isDeleted=true, status=cancelled). Requires JWT + admin.

item.name: Payments
item.description: Payment endpoints for QR and webhook flow

request.description: Create QR payment info for an order. Works for qrCode/ewallet payment method.
Get payment status of an order, including paymentState and paymentStatus.
Manual webhook test with SePay payload format. Authorization header must be `Apikey <token>` (SEPAY_API_TOKEN). Content should include `DH{orderId}` to match order.
Local/dev only endpoint to simulate SePay callback success. Payload: orderId, optional transferAmount (default uses order total).

item.name: Promotions
item.description: Promotion management endpoints

request.description: Get promotions list. Requires JWT.
Get one promotion by id. Requires JWT.
Create promotion. Requires JWT + admin.
Update promotion by id. Requires JWT + admin.
Update promotion status. Requires JWT + admin.
Apply a promo code to check discount. Public endpoint. Body: code (required), orderTotal (required), store_id (optional).
Soft delete promotion. Requires JWT + admin.

item.name: Revenue
item.description: Revenue analytics endpoints from completed orders only. Requires JWT with admin/manager role. Manager is always scoped to their own store.

request.description: Get overview metrics from completed orders (`status=completed`, `isDeleted=false`) in a date range. Query params: startDate, endDate, optional store_id, optional paymentMethod (cash|card|qrCode|ewallet), optional order_type (carry_out|dine_in|delivery).
Get grouped metrics from completed orders. `dimension` supports store|paymentMethod|order_type. Supports same optional filters as overview.

item.name: Activity Logs
item.description: Activity log endpoints for system events. Requires JWT. GET is limited to admin/manager.

request.description: Create an activity log entry. Actor fields are auto-filled from JWT if omitted. Requires JWT.
Get activity logs with filters. Supports store_id, actor_id, actor_type, module_source, target_model, action, from, to, page, limit. Requires JWT + admin/manager.

item.name: Media
item.description: Cloudinary media upload/delete endpoints

request.description: Upload up to 5 product images. Field name: images (file array).
Upload up to 5 combo images. Field name: combos (file array).
Upload ingredient image. Field name: image (single file).
Upload category icon. Field name: icon (single file).
Delete image by Cloudinary publicId query parameter.
